
From the Lojban web site FAQ (http://www.lojban.org/files/brochures/faq.htm):

'''brivla''': any word that can state a relationship among several objects or concepts, and thus be the core word in a Lojban [[jbocre: bridi|bridi]] -- a "predicate word"

brivla are in the main [[jbocre: gismu|gismu]], [[jbocre: lujvo|lujvo]] and [[jbocre: fu'ivla|fu'ivla]]. A few [[jbocre: cmavo|cmavo]] can also behave as [[jbocre: brivla|brivla]].

----

As noted above, these words state a relationship, and not an entire [[jbocre: bridi|bridi]], so a better word is [[jbocre: selbrivla|selbrivla]], i.e. ''valsi lo selbri'' (a word which means a [[jbocre: selbri|selbri]]).

----

Why isn't it [[jbocre: brivo|brivo]]?

If vo was a rafsi for valsi for purposes of making a few new gismu (cmavo = cmalu valsi, lujvo = pluja valsi), why not for this one?
